keyFindings.description: PR #2323 conflicts with main e82b013b66ff (#2324, the tab's event-driven refetch). GitHub reports CONFLICTING/DIRTY, and `git merge-tree` shows conflicts in packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md, web/src/__tests__/sse-reconnect.test.tsx, web/src/api/sse.ts and internal/dispatch/api/routes_table_test.go. A correct resolution keeps main's `onOpen({ replayComplete })` and its refresh only when the replay is incomplete. In sse.ts the PR changes only a comment, so its spread wording must apply to the non-replay branch alone. The resolution also keeps main's EVENT_REPLAY_HEADER/StreamOpened beside the PR's RECONNECT_SPREAD_MS and jittered reconnectDelayMs in live.ts, keeps the sse-reconnect timer row at RECONNECT_SPREAD_MS + 1_000, and sets the routes pin to 142 (main's 141 plus /api/v1/dashboard/builds). Merge main, then the tester runs the head.

verified: Merge 8675beea of main d47dbf05 (#2390 on main): the deep review compared the PR's changed lines before and after the merge, file by file. 59 of 73 files are identical. The other 14 are explained by main's changes, field alignment and the CHANGELOG entries moved into .changes/unreleased fragments. Nothing of INFRA-555 is reverted or duplicated. The registry takes dashboardBuild.Build (cmd/dispatch/main.go:539). Boot order is publish (main.go:268), then listen, then register (main.go:537).

274bdf2a (signin.multiprocess.e2e.ts and the harness oidc mode): the deep review ran the spec and it passed; harness-signin unit tests 7 pass. DISPATCH_E2E_SIGNIN is read only by the e2e harness and CI, and oidc mode mounts no dev sign-in. The tester's forged-cookie negative controls are refused with 400.
ci: Required set: lint, typecheck, test, pr-title. CI head 274bdf2a; the compare to cb08c3cf holds only .legion/ (2 files). The required checks were queued when read and none has passed; this round requests changes on the conflict, so I did not wait.
thermonuclear: Pair run once at cb08c3cf (code 274bdf2a). The deep review approves, with no Medium or High finding, and gives the conflict-resolution guidance above. The code quality review found cleanup only, with no behaviour change: a test helper copied from round-robin-proxy.test.ts into harness-signin.test.ts, the oidc/processes mode decided in both harness-ports.ts and harness-listeners.ts, a sign-in check split across two blocks of run-server.sh, two ternaries in playwright.config.ts, env-shape assertions in harness-signin.test.ts, and the DISPATCH_E2E_SIGNIN_* mapping repeated in packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md.
